bahrain.title: Compromise may end deadlock over BD 100,000 capital rule for foreign firms
bahrain.summary: A bill requiring wholly foreign-owned companies to hold at least BD 100,000 in capital, stuck in Parliament for three years over fears it would deter investors, has been withdrawn for two weeks so its sponsors can rewrite it with a more flexible approach.

bahrain.title: MPs approve tougher law on labour housing in family areas
bahrain.summary: Parliament unanimously backed a proposed law that would fine landlords and employers who break accommodation rules up to BD 5,000, with possible jail and cuts to electricity and water. It aims to stop family neighbourhoods becoming crowded labour quarters and sets one framework across all four governorates.

bahrain.title: Parliament backs call to delay health insurance fees for expat workers
bahrain.summary: MPs unanimously approved an urgent proposal asking the Cabinet to postpone new health insurance fees for expatriate employees, so companies are not hit with extra costs before the scheme is properly organised. The Cabinet will now review it.

bahrain.title: MPs propose one-off BD 100 payment to citizens for living costs
bahrain.summary: An urgent proposal for a BD 100 support payment to Bahraini citizens, to help with costs such as groceries, petrol and government fees, was unanimously approved by Parliament and sent to the Cabinet for consideration.

bahrain.title: Cityscape Bahrain shows around $10 billion of property projects
bahrain.summary: The fifth Cityscape Bahrain at Exhibition World in Sakhir is its biggest yet, with projects worth about $10 billion from more than 40 exhibitors including the main master developers. Organisers expect 8,000 to 9,000 visitors over the five days.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Clear portal cuts investor account opening to about 10 minutes
bahrain.summary: Bahrain Clear, part of Bahrain Bourse, launched an Investor Account Management Portal that lets brokers open client accounts and register National Investor Numbers in as little as 10 minutes, removing repeated verification steps for individuals and companies.

bahrain.title: Bahrain Marina to reopen first phase to the public within weeks
bahrain.summary: The first phase of the redeveloped Bahrain Marina waterfront is due to open to the public in a few weeks, with handovers of Bahrain Marina Residence homes starting in the first quarter of 2027. The project mixes housing, retail and leisure.

bahrain.title: Bapco Energies awards five-year well services contract to MBPS
bahrain.summary: Bapco Energies signed a five-year deal with MB Petroleum Services for onshore workover and well intervention work across the Bahrain Field, using 550 HP and 750 HP rigs to support production, well integrity and field development.

crypto.title: 21Shares says weak demand and liquidations, not the Binance hack, drove Bitcoin's slide
crypto.summary: A 21Shares report says the October Binance hack started the sell-off, but falling demand and forced selling did most damage, with $5.8 billion liquidated in the week to 15 November. It sees Bitcoin over a year into a bear market and flags $53,250 as a key level.

crypto.title: Utah moves to drop criminal charges against Kalshi after it leaves the state
crypto.summary: Utah's attorney general asked to dismiss 14 criminal charges against Kalshi and its co-founders after the platform blocked Utah users, but can refile if it returns. A civil suit continues, and six other prediction market firms agreed to stop serving Utah.

crypto.title: CleanSpark posts $987 million annual loss and may sell more Bitcoin than it mines
crypto.summary: Miner CleanSpark swung to a $987 million loss for the year to 30 September, mostly from the falling value of its Bitcoin, with revenue down 25% to $576.5 million. Its CFO said it may sell slightly more BTC than it produces each quarter to reduce treasury risk.

crypto.title: USDT buyers on Moscow Exchange face 22% VAT when crypto trading opens
crypto.summary: Moscow Exchange's clearinghouse will charge 22% VAT on USDT trades from the 1 December launch until 31 December, because Russian tax law exempts Bitcoin and Ether but not USDT, which is classed differently. It has asked tax authorities for guidance.

crypto.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles security team, calls AI a more urgent risk than quantum
crypto.summary: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team ahead of an overhaul of how validators and users sign and verify data. A researcher said the upgrade is harder than the Merge with less time, and AI now poses a more pressing threat than quantum computing.

crypto.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
crypto.summary: According to the headline, JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX have completed the first digital gold trades in London; the full article could not be read.
